title: Coherence of iterated source-open coefficient restriction
statement:
Let g′:X′→X be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], K∈D(X), K′∈D(X′),
φ:L_g′K→K′ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback], and Z≤W opens of X.
Put A=W.ι⁻¹Z, P=X′×_X W with p:P→X′, q:P→W, B=P×_W A with r:B→P,t:B→A,
and P_Z=X′×_X Z with p_Z:P_Z→X′,q_Z:P_Z→Z. Let e:A≅Z be Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE,
and e′:B≅P_Z any isomorphism with e′p_Z=rp and e′q_Z=te.
Using the fixed composition comparisons c [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition],
set K_W=L_W.ι K, K_W′=L_p K′. Define φ_W by c(q,W.ι), transport qW.ι=pg′,
c(p,g′) inverse and L_pφ; define φ_Z analogously. Define φ_A by c(t,A.ι),
transport tA.ι=rq, c(r,q) inverse and L_rφ_W. Define
α:L_e L_Z.ι K≅L_A.ι K_W by c(e,Z.ι), transport eZ.ι=A.ιW.ι, c(A.ι,W.ι) inverse;
define β:L_e′ L_p_Z K′≅L_r K_W′ by c(e′,p_Z), transport e′p_Z=rp,
c(r,p) inverse. Then L_t(α.hom) followed by φ_A equals c(t,e).hom at L_Z.ι K,
transport te=e′q_Z, c(e′,q_Z) inverse, L_e′φ_Z and β.hom. No direct image or
base-change comparison is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Apply coefficient-square pasting to the two pullback squares, using their projection conditions to prove the rectangle commutes. Expand alpha and beta and distribute L_t over alpha. Cancel the inverse source comparison against the forward source comparison from pasting. Apply coefficient-square coordinate change to the rectangle, with e=isoOfLE.hom and b=e′.hom, using isoOfLE_hom_ι, hp and hq. Append the inverse target comparison c(r,p); associativity gives exactly beta.hom and the displayed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem singleComplex_nested_coefficient_coherence
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (phi : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (W Z : X.Opens) (hZW : Z ≤ W)
    (e' : pullback (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z).ι ≅ pullback g' Z.ι)
    (hp : e'.hom ≫ pullback.fst g' Z.ι =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z).ι ≫ pullback.fst g' W.ι)
    (hq : e'.hom ≫ pullback.snd g' Z.ι =
      pullback.snd (pullback.snd g' W.ι) (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z).ι ≫
        (Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE hZW).hom) :
    let c := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
    let A := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z
    let e := Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE hZW
    let q := pullback.snd g' W.ι
    let p := pullback.fst g' W.ι
    let t := pullback.snd q A.ι
    let r := pullback.fst q A.ι
    let KW := (derivedPullback W.ι).obj K
    let KW' := (derivedPullback p).obj K'
    let phiW := (c q W.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := W.ι)).symm) ≫
      (c p g').inv.app K ≫ (derivedPullback p).map phi
    let phiZ := (c (pullback.snd g' Z.ι) Z.ι).hom.app K ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (pullback.condition (f := g') (g := Z.ι)).symm) ≫
      (c (pullback.fst g' Z.ι) g').inv.app K ≫
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' Z.ι)).map phi
    let phiA := (c t A.ι).hom.app KW ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj KW)
        (pullback.condition (f := q) (g := A.ι)).symm) ≫
      (c r q).inv.app KW ≫ (derivedPullback r).map phiW
    let alpha := (c e.hom Z.ι).app K ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K)
        (Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE_hom_ι hZW)) ≪≫ (c A.ι W.ι).symm.app K
    let beta := (c e'.hom (pullback.fst g' Z.ι)).app K' ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj K') hp) ≪≫
      (c r p).symm.app K'
    (derivedPullback t).map alpha.hom ≫ phiA =
      (c t e.hom).hom.app ((derivedPullback Z.ι).obj K) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj
        ((derivedPullback Z.ι).obj K)) hq.symm) ≫
      (c e'.hom (pullback.snd g' Z.ι)).inv.app ((derivedPullback Z.ι).obj K) ≫
      (derivedPullback e'.hom).map phiZ ≫ beta.hom
